name: Stalker

62308.name: Stalker Drive - First Strike
62308.SpecificEffects:
Upon deployment, immediately gains <buf ID=3004412>[Stealth II]</buf>, lasting <color=#F74848>2</color> turns.
At the end of action, if there are no enemies within <color=#F74848>1</color> tile, gains <buf ID=3004412>[Stealth II]</buf>, lasting <color=#F74848>2</color> turns. This effect has a <color=#F74848>3</color>-turn trigger interval.
When actively attacking for the <color=#F74848>1st</color> time each turn, DMG <color=#F74848>+7.5%</color> and Crit Rate <color=#F74848>+5%</color>.
ST Body HP <color=#F74848>+10%</color> and DMG Dealt <color=#F74848>+5%</color>.

RelatedDescription: An upgraded version of the legacy Stealth Amplifier. This advanced optics system can distort light, allowing ST fitted with this backpack model to become somewhat invisible. It can also enhance the capability of an ST's first attack per turn.
